Fundraising expertise shaped by advisory and investment experience.

Thomas Hudson brings over a decade of professional experience, with a career spanning venture capital investment and corporate finance advisory.

As the former Head of PwC’s Series A fundraising team, he led more than 20 transactions with a combined value exceeding £100 million, before becoming an Investment Director at the Scottish National Investment Bank.

A prize-winning Chartered Accountant with a senior network across the venture capital market, Thomas helps founders prepare and execute successful fundraises while strengthening the finance function required to scale.
